sectionText.title: From Photo to Motion: AI Character Motion Swap
sectionText.description: Upload a photo and a reference video, and your character starts moving just like the clip you picked. No filming, no animation skills needed.

sections.beforeImageAlt: Before and after: a still photo and its animated result

sectionText.description:
• Natural Motion: Your character moves smoothly and realistically, matching the reference video.
  • Still Looks Like You: Faces, proportions and style carry through, so the result still looks like your original photo or character.
  • Multiple AI Models: Choose from three models, each tuned for a different result.

sections.title: How to Use AI Character Motion Swap

blocks.subtitle: Choose a Model
blocks.description: Pick the model built for your goal: Character Motion Control, Replace the Character in a Video, or Apply Video Motion to Photo.

blocks.subtitle: Upload a Motion Reference Video
blocks.description: Add a source video with the movement you want to apply: a gesture, a performance or a dance.

blocks.subtitle: Upload Your Photo
blocks.description: Upload the photo you want to animate: a portrait, a character illustration or any image with a clear subject.

blocks.subtitle: Generate and Save
blocks.description: Click Generate, preview your result and download it in HD, or find it saved in My Gallery.

sectionText.title: Turn Any Photo Into Motion: 3 Ways to Use AI Character Motion Swap

sections.beforeImageAlt: A portrait photo moving like a dance clip

sectionText.title: Make Any Photo Move
sectionText.description: Upload a reference video, such as a dance clip, a walking shot or a simple gesture, and pair it with your photo. AI Character Motion Swap applies that motion to your image and builds a video from it. A strong fit for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, where dynamic motion holds attention.

sections.beforeImageAlt: An illustrated character animated with a reference clip

sectionText.title: Give Any Character Real Motion
sectionText.description: Animate illustrated or AI-generated characters without 3D modeling or frame-by-frame drawing. Upload your character image and a reference video, and get smooth motion that mirrors every move while faces, proportions and art style stay consistent from first frame to last. Useful for storytelling, avatars and character content.

sections.beforeImageAlt: A person swapped into an action clip

sectionText.title: Swap Yourself Into Any Scene
sectionText.description: Skip the filming and the manual masking. Upload your photo alongside any action clip, and your character replaces the original performer while keeping the clip's motion, gestures and camera movement intact. Built for memes, reaction videos and social content where believable motion is the whole point.

faqList.question: What do I need to start?
faqList.answer: One photo with a clear subject and one reference video with the motion you want.

faqList.question: Which model should I pick?
faqList.answer: Character Motion Control moves a photo. Replace the Character in a Video swaps you into a clip. Apply Video Motion to Photo animates illustrated or AI-generated characters.

faqList.question: Does the result keep my face and style?
faqList.answer: Yes. Faces, proportions and art style carry through from the original image.

faqList.question: What kind of reference video works best?
faqList.answer: A clip with one clear subject and visible full-body or upper-body motion, such as a gesture, performance or dance.

faqList.question: Can I animate an illustration or AI-generated character?
faqList.answer: Yes. Use Apply Video Motion to Photo.

faqList.question: Where is my result saved?
faqList.answer: You can download it in HD, and it is saved in My Gallery.

faqList.question: Do I need animation or 3D skills?
faqList.answer: No. The tool needs only a photo and a reference video.

faqList.question: Can I use it for social videos?
faqList.answer: Yes. Results fit TikTok, Reels, Shorts, memes and reaction videos.
